title: pedilonum lawesii
intro: Pedilonum lawesii, commonly known as the native Hawaiian fern or Hawaiian tree fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyatheaceae. It has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat coughs, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pedilonum lawesii include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
